headline.en: Spatial audio is now part of the index
headline.zh: 空间音频正式加入索引

summary.en: This update adds 43 papers, 32 open-source projects, and 11 datasets spanning binaural generation, Ambisonics production, HRTF personalization, and spatial evaluation. You can now move from a research topic to its code and data without searching across separate lists.
summary.zh: 这次更新补充了 43 篇论文、32 个开源项目和 11 个数据集，覆盖双耳生成、Ambisonics 制作、HRTF 个性化和空间音频评测。现在从研究方向出发，就能顺着索引找到对应代码和数据，不用再分散搜索。

note.en: IEM Plug-in Suite is a practical Ambisonics toolkit for encoding, rotating, visualizing, reverberating, and decoding spatial mixes.
note.zh: IEM Plug-in Suite 是一套可以直接用于 Ambisonics 制作的插件，覆盖编码、旋转、可视化、混响和解码。

note.en: Ambisonizer shows how neural upmixing can turn lower-channel audio into an Ambisonics representation.
note.zh: Ambisonizer 展示了如何用神经网络把较少声道的音频上混成 Ambisonics 表征。

note.en: BEWO-1M provides more than one million audio-text pairs with explicit source-motion information for spatial generation research.
note.zh: BEWO-1M 提供超过一百万组音频文本对，并带有明确的声源运动信息，适合空间音频生成研究。
